confirmed_findings.mechanism: Hourly interval splitting uses host Date.setMinutes/setHours/getHours; transitions use host getHours. Absolute date renderers pass locale only, so dateFormat uses browser timezone. Existing useDateFormat resolves the saved vehicle/user/UTC mode, but is not consumed by this page or its calculation. Label 'local hour' does not disclose which analytical zone.
confirmed_findings.repro: With browser America/Los_Angeles and saved tz_display_default='utc', a 2026-07-01T10:30:00Z sample displays/buckets in browser hour 03, not selected UTC hour 10. Saving UTC cannot affect summary: useMemo depends on samples only. This is a source-derived reproduction, not a browser/settings mutation.
confirmed_findings.fix: Reuse existing useDateFormat/useTimezone and resolve/disclose one analytical timezone; coordinate explicit timezone-aware hourly splitting and transition allocation while keeping elapsed SI seconds and DST conservation. Changing display labels alone is insufficient. Never guess a vehicle timezone.

conditional_candidates.mechanism: HVAC power/A-C accept strict booleans; fan inputs accept finite numbers and use >0. An enum-only HVAC power/fan-status payload can remain unknown or have a nonsemantic positive code interpreted active. Climate handler maps raw signal values, not watts, and TS typing is not wire proof.
conditional_candidates.repro_needed: Obtain authorized boolean/enum wire-contract fixtures from the actual signal owner, then test all recognized On/Off/Unknown and fan enum values, including negative/invalid values. No backend/API/device calls or broad signal-catalog audit were made.
conditional_candidates.disposition: Conditional integration contract candidate, not a confirmed production bug. Preserve existing strict/active-wins semantics until an exact supported enum mapping is established. Never convert hvacPower into W/kW or infer energy.

conditional_candidates.mechanism: Some t() count arguments remain raw numbers instead of fmtInt; most metrics use the reactive saved-number preference hook. Page tests mock t() and therefore cannot establish canonical plural/grouping/localized-digit behavior.

conditional_candidates.disposition: Conditional localization candidate, not confirmed untranslated English or a request to edit catalogs.

data_source.backend_source: internal/api/climate/handler.go:80-116; StateReader.Timeline(r.Context()); default seven calendar days; change-feed rows forward-fold fields. Handler alone does not prove exclusive end semantics or signal enum meanings.
data_source.hvac_semantics: hvacPower/isAcOn are strict boolean state inputs under current TS/domain contract, not numeric power. Any interpretable active signal wins; absent/invalid-only state is null. Finite fan values use >0; supported enum mapping remains conditional C01.
data_source.raw_si_and_signs: Durations and thresholds stay in seconds, timestamps in epoch milliseconds/UTC source. No W/kW, energy, thermal efficiency or temperature inference. Display durations use existing useUnits; fractions become percent only at display. No physical negative power/temperature/distance values are presented by this page, so no sign-changing display is established. Negative finite fan input resolving off is retained tested behavior, not a newly guessed physical interpretation.
data_source.freshness: Shared header query-driven freshness/age/manual refetch; history remains labeled non-live and source-only. Individual signal measurement timestamps are not supplied by flat forward-folded rows, so row cadence is not per-signal measurement freshness.

states.authoritative_empty: Successful [] yields real zero returned-row accounting and balanced identities; ratios/quantiles remain null, interval/run claims withheld. This is distinct from unknown state or unresolved source.
states.unknown_and_partial: Strict invalid-only rows stay unknown. Unique timestamp-valid unknowns are timeline continuity barriers, not removed gaps. Long gaps censor runs; known sample before unknown endpoint may support a step interval per disclosed method, but cannot establish an observed transition.
states.measured_zero: Known-off observed intervals yield real 0 on-duty; no observed denominator yields null duty, not 0. Only complete transition-bounded active runs enter short-rate denominator. Empty complete denominator stays null even if censored on-fragments exist.
states.coverage: First returned duplicate at a timestamp retained; terminal sample separate; exact row/pair/run/duration identities; rows remain full returned source despite directory display cap. No maintenance diagnosis inferred.
